thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx gateway errors detected for private-vpc customers in eu-west-1 (gateway errors + timeouts). Error rate spike from 0.2% -> 7.8% in last 5m :rotating_light:
Priya: paging oncall (I'm oncall). I'm pulling logs now. Any immediate customers on Dedicated/Private? @CS-Team pls add customer-facing note if we think impact > 1%.
Sam: seeing a lot of 502/504 from our edge envoy proxies. TCP resets ~in same minute. first look: NAT gateway error logs show connection timeout to downstream inference pool nodes.
Alice: I can grab VPC flow logs and route table. quick checks: peering connection status shows intermittent DOWN events for peer-rtb-0a1b2c.
Miguel: confirmed. peering connection state flips between available and deleting in Cloud console around the same timestamps as 5xx spike.
Priya: assign mitigation. Sam you take network mid, Alice do routing/peering, Miguel check NAT and conntrack metrics. I'll coordinate and update CS.
Sam: running curl and tcpdump on gateway node: `curl -v https://private-gateway.internal/health` -> hangs then 504. tcpdump shows SYN retransmits to worker ENI IPs.
Alice: route tables look ok. BGP not used here, it's VPC peering. VPC peering status is flapping. I see Resource ID: pcx-0abcde flagged DELETING and then AVAILABLE.
Miguel: NAT metrics: high connection errors on NAT gateway in eu-west-1a. Instance-based NAT (legacy) hit conntrack limit. conntrack count = 196k. sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 196608. we need to bump.
Priya: potential root cause hypothesis: transient peering control-plane errors combined with a saturated NAT conntrack on instance NAT -> ports exhausted -> gateway returning 502/504. Aim: reduce new connections + raise conntrack + reroute traffic to healthy AZ NAT.
eng-sre-bot: runbook link: https://runbook.internal/net/nat-conntrack -> suggests three-step mitigation: 1) increase conntrack limit, 2) add short-term route to alternate NAT, 3) open support case with cloud provider.
Sam: I'm adding iptables rule to drop suspicious ephemeral flooding connections for now (rate-limiting) and switching edge to use NAT in eu-west-1b by updating route priority. commands run: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `sudo iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m connlimit --connlimit-above 200 -j DROP`
Alice: while Sam does that, I'm recreating the peering in a safe window. creating replacement peering pcx-0f1e2d. also detaching problematic route propagation for the flaky peer temporarily.
Miguel: NAT scaling: spinning up replacement NAT instance in eu-west-1b and attaching Elastic IP, testing connectivity to inference pool. `ss -s` shows conntrack table decreasing after sysctl change.
Priya: CS note draft: "We're investigating elevated gateway errors affecting customers on Private/VPC in eu-west-1. Engineers are actively mitigating; some requests may see 502/504 or timeouts. We expect diminishing errors in the next 15-30 minutes. We'll post updates every 15 mins." @CS-Team please send.
CS-Team: posted to affected customers and updated status page. included temporary mitigations and ETA 30m.
Sam: after route priority change and conntrack bump, error rate dropped to 1.1% in 10m. still seeing occasional 502s from one AZ.
Alice: new peering pcx-0f1e2d is ACTIVE and routes propagated. removing old flaky peer from route table now.
Miguel: NAT instance metrics stabilized. conntrack now at 58k, tcp retransmits dropped.
Priya: handoff note for next oncall: we lowered conntrack max, temporarily rate-limited outgoing connections on gateway, failed over routes to NAT in eu-west-1b, and recreated VPC peering. follow-ups: 1) replace instance NAT with managed NAT Gateway for AZ redundancy, 2) add conntrack alert threshold to 60% and autoscale NAT replacements, 3) post-incident RCA.
Sam: logs + pcap saved to s3://redwood-incidents/1771254321/ for forensic. runbook steps executed logged in incident tracker.
Alice: marking incident as "mitigation in place". continuing to monitor 30m.
Miguel: will open cloud support ticket re: peering control-plane flaps and ask for internal region health check.
Priya: thanks team. next update in 15m or sooner if regressions. :white_check_mark:
